description: Conformance cases for the two v3 readers: direction command is the helper reading the owner's lines (ParseVoiceControlCommandV3), direction event is the owner reading the helper's (ParseVoiceControlEventV3). The forms and results are those of voice-control/cases.json; a hello never comes out of the v3 event reader (the hello is v1, read before the version is chosen), so there is no offers field. The framing rules are v1's and v2's and are not repeated case by case here beyond one of each code; what these cases pin is what v3 adds: set_share_audio and set_share_audio_mute, the state's share_audio, share_audio_muted, share_audio_problem and share_audio_sources and the rules that hold them together, that v2's rules stand unchanged beside them, and that the v3 readers take a line of no other version. What a string may hold is in cases-strings.json.
